in_sanskrit.name: रुपा
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: She who embodies or assumes a particular form, shape, or appearance. In Hindu mythology, Rupa is an aspect of the goddess Lakshmi, representing her beautiful, physical form.

in_marathi.name: Rupa
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Form, Beauty, Wealth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Rupa हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Rupa means 'form', 'shape', 'appearance', 'beauty', 'wealth', or 'prosperity'. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'rup' meaning 'form'. In Hinduism, Rupa is considered a divine name and is associated with the goddess Lakshmi, who represents wealth and prosperity.

It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'rup' meaning 'form'. In Hinduism, Rupa is considered a divine name and is associated with the goddess Lakshmi, who represents wealth and prosperity.
